guarantees.claim: rx_thresh_val is set to RxFifoDepthW'(RxFifoDepth - 2) when uart_fifo_rxilvl equals RxFifoDepthW-1; when uart_fifo_rxilvl > RxFifoDepthW-1, rx_thresh_val is all-ones; otherwise it is 1'b1 << uart_fifo_rxilvl.
event_rx_watermark is asserted when rx_fifo_depth >= rx_thresh_val, otherwise deasserted.

assumptions.claim: The localparam RxFifoDepthW must be ≥ 1; otherwise the case item RxFifoDepthW-1 wraps to a large integer and may spuriously match uart_fifo_rxilvl.
assumptions.risk: If RxFifoDepthW = 0, the case item becomes a very large value, potentially matching legal uart_fifo_rxilvl values and causing rx_thresh_val to be set to RxFifoDepth-2 instead of the default branch.

uncertain_points.claim: If RxFifoDepthW can be 0, the case label RxFifoDepthW-1 will be a large two's-complement number, possibly matching a legal value of uart_fifo_rxilvl and leading to an unintended rx_thresh_val assignment of RxFifoDepth-2.
uncertain_points.risk: Watermark threshold may be set to an unexpected value, causing incorrect event generation.

uncertain_points.claim: For the highest fifo level index (RxFifoDepthW-1), the threshold is set to RxFifoDepth-2, which deviates from the bit-shift pattern used for lower levels. The intent is not documented in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: If the value is wrong, the receive watermark event may be generated at an incorrect fill level, impacting flow control or interrupt timing.
